'''2007 New York State Championship Michael Pistone LS An Unusual Amount Of Fear''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Michael Pistone]] at [[2007 New York State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|An Unusual Amount Of Fear|Ref3-L-anunusualamountoffear.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Constrained Optimization
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
